import subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib
prog='tests/cases/concurrency/race-lost-update.lwt'
tmp=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='lwt-rt-'))/'trace.json'
rec=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','lwt','--schedule=random:6','--schedule-log='+str(tmp),prog],capture_output=True)
rep=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','lwt','--schedule-replay='+str(tmp),prog],capture_output=True)
ok=rec.returncode==0 and rep.returncode==0 and rec.stdout==rep.stdout and tmp.exists()
print('OK' if ok else f'MISS rec={rec.returncode} rep={rep.returncode} same={rec.stdout==rep.stdout}')
